sentences.text:
Since a reference is already been filed by the Petitioner before the
Collector under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land
Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, Mr. Joshi, learned Counsel for the
Petitioner, upon instructions, seeks to withdraw the Petition.
3. The Petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
4. Pending application/s, if any, shall stand disposed of accordingly.
